correctness.rationale: Complete symbolic proof: every nonzero subset power corresponds to a directed support walk; cyclic supports never become zero; acyclic supports vanish at the longest-path cutoff with zero present from the second power. Unique longest-path layers yield an exact weighted composition census. Group labels are arbitrary nonempty subsets at each arc; no cancellation is possible. The top-index and total follow algebraically. Independently enumerated all DAGs through n=4 and g=1,2,4 and all actual nonempty subset products for seven smaller cases; both procedures output VERIFY_OK. Finite checks are corroboration rather than infinite proof.

scientific_limits: Only nonempty subsets; empty subset would create an additional absorbing element under the full powerset convention.
Nilpotent individuals in the power semigroup are not the same objects as nilpotent closed subsemigroups of the underlying Brandt semigroup.
No independent mathematical audit or definitive historical priority certification.

value.rationale: The invariant is the full nilpotency-index distribution of individual elements in a naturally occurring finite inverse-semigroup power construction, across all n and all finite group labels. Exact closed coefficients and the sharp maximal-index multiplicity answer a complete structural enumeration problem, and reveal invariance under replacement of G by a nonisomorphic group of equal order. The result goes beyond isolated small examples, even though some ingredients are classical; no universal downstream theorem is claimed.
